in_hebrew.name: Siobhan
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is gracious
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Siobhan הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Irish name Sibghne, meaning ‘God is gracious’. This name was popularized in the English-speaking world by the character Siobhan McKenna in the novel 'The Blue Lagoon' by Henry De Vere Stacpoole.

This name was popularized in the English-speaking world by the character Siobhan McKenna in the novel 'The Blue Lagoon' by Henry De Vere Stacpoole.
